name: Dris
source:
Dris possesses a noble character and is willing to make concessions to the main heroiс. He is one of those who know more than the others, showing deep insight and awareness. Dris is unafraid of risky, bold, and even radical actions.

Little is known about Dris’s past, except that he may have lost his family during the war against Beexen’s ghosts. By the beginning of The Beexen’s Tale, he is a member of the resistance movement opposing Beexen’s ghosts.
